# moz-utils: Open Source Utility Library for Mozambique
> Official specification and developer context for AI Agents and LLMs.
> Website & Documentation: https://iradoweck.github.io/moz-utils/
> Source Repository: https://github.com/iradoweck/moz-utils

## Core Philosophy
- Multi-ecosystem parity: Available with identical contracts across TypeScript, Python, PHP, Dart, and Kotlin.
- Zero runtime dependencies: Relies solely on each language's standard libraries.
- Offline-first: Full local validation for NUIT, BI, DIRE, Passports, NIB, IBAN, and Postal Codes (CEP).
- Version: 0.4.0

---

## 1. Telecom & Mobile Wallets
Prefixes:
- Vodacom: 84, 85 -> Mobile Wallet: M-Pesa
- Tmcel: 82, 83 -> Mobile Wallet: mKesh
- Movitel: 86, 87, 88 -> Mobile Wallet: e-Mola

Function Signatures:
- isValidMozambicanPhone(phone: string): boolean
- formatMozambicanPhone(phone: string, options?: { format: 'international' | 'e164' | 'national' | 'dashed' }): string
- getMobileOperator(phone: string): 'Vodacom' | 'Tmcel' | 'Movitel' | null
- getMobileWallet(phone: string): 'M-Pesa' | 'mKesh' | 'e-Mola' | null
- buildWhatsAppUrl(phone: string, message?: string): string

---

## 2. Fiscal and Identity Documents
NUIT (Taxpayer ID):
- 9 numeric digits.
- Official weighted algorithm (Weights: [8, 9, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9] modulo 11).
- Entity Types by 1st digit:
  1, 2: Pessoas Singulares
  4: Pessoas Colectivas (Companies)
  5: Entidades Equiparadas
  6: Estado / Instituições Públicas
  7, 8: Outras Entidades
  9: Entidades Estrangeiras / Não-Residentes

BI (National ID):
- 12 numeric digits followed by 1 uppercase control letter (e.g. 110100123456A).

Function Signatures:
- isValidNUIT(nuit: string | number): boolean
- formatNUIT(nuit: string | number): string
- getNUITEntityType(nuit: string | number): string | null
- isValidBI(bi: string): boolean
- isValidDIRE(dire: string): boolean
- isValidPassport(passport: string): boolean
- isValidDrivingLicense(license: string): boolean

---

## 3. Banking System (NIB & IBAN)
NIB (Número de Identificação Bancária):
- 21 numeric digits: 4 digits Bank Code + 4 digits Branch Code + 12 digits Account Number + 2 digits Checksum.
- Checksum: ISO 7064 Modulo 97-10 (98 - ((19 digits * 100) % 97)).

IBAN:
- Format: "MZ59" + 21 digits NIB (total 25 characters).

Major Bank Codes:
- 0001: Millennium BIM
- 0008: BCI (Banco Comercial e de Investimentos)
- 0003: Standard Bank
- 0004: Absa Bank Moçambique
- 0007: Moza Banco
- 0010: Nedbank Moçambique
- 0021: FNB Moçambique

Function Signatures:
- isValidNIB(nib: string): boolean
- formatNIB(nib: string, separator?: ' ' | '.'): string
- getBankFromNIB(nib: string): { code: string, name: string, shortName: string } | null
- nibToIBAN(nib: string): string
- isValidIBAN(iban: string): boolean

---

## 4. Currency (MZN / Meticais)
- formatMZN(value: number, currency?: 'MT' | 'MZN'): string -> Formats e.g. 1500 -> "1.500,00 MT"
- parseMZN(value: string): number | null -> Parses strings like "1.500,00 MZN" to 1500.0

---

## 5. Geography & Postal Codes
- 11 Provinces: Cabo Delgado, Gaza, Inhambane, Manica, Maputo Cidade, Maputo Província, Nampula, Niassa, Sofala, Tete, Zambézia.
- getDistrictsByProvince(provinceIdentifier: string): string[] -> Accepts ID ("1"), Acronym ("NPL", "MPM"), or full name ("Nampula", case & accent insensitive).
- isValidPostalCode(code: string): boolean -> Legacy 4 digits (e.g. "1100").
- isValidNewCEP(cep: string): boolean -> Modern 6-digit CEP (format "XXXX-XX").
- suggestCEPs(query: string): Array<{ cep: string, province: string, district: string, locality: string }> -> Offline search engine.

---

## 6. Sanitization
- isValidName(name: string): boolean -> Requires >= 2 alphabetic characters.
- sanitizeName(name: string, options?: { allCaps?: boolean }): string -> Enforces strict Title Case while keeping particles lowercase ('de', 'da', 'do', 'dos', 'das', 'e').
- sanitizeDocumentField(value: string): string -> Strips special characters, keeps only uppercase alphanumeric.
